name: The Glass Cathedral in the Sky
act: Act IV: The High Solarium & Solar Focus
description: Act IV climax staging ground: Monumental airborne cathedral spun from solar-melted asteroid glass. The party must align or shatter the Solarium Mirrors before the Stasis Coffin reaches the Solar Focus.

cast.name: The Solar Celebrant
cast.description: Conducts the First Cast at the equatorial gimbal ring, seeking to vitrify or awaken the sleeper inside the Stasis Coffin.

cast.name: Pell the Twice-Tested
cast.description: Must choose between delivering the coffin to the Solar Focus, shattering the containment, or locking it by Canon Warrant.

primitives.name: High Chancel Solar Focus Lens & Gimbal Dais
primitives.stage_role: Act IV Climax Altar: Concentrates solar light onto the Chancel Cradle
primitives.description: Three-tiered glass dais supporting an equatorial gimbal ring and biconvex astronomical lens where the Cast occurs.

primitives.name: Solarium Articulated Alignment Mirror
primitives.stage_role: Interactive Optical Puzzle: Rotates to redirect or diffuse the solar beam
primitives.description: Concave parabolic reflector dish set in a bronze trunnion fork atop an octagonal pedestal with handwheel orientation.

primitives.name: Hexagonal Borosilicate Stasis Coffin
primitives.stage_role: The Delivered Consignment on the Focal Cradle
primitives.description: The smuggled cryogenic coffin placed upon the chancel focal cradle under the burning lens.

primitives.name: Fluted Asteroid-Glass Cathedral Column
primitives.stage_role: Nave Cover Pillar: Refracts and blocks sweeping solar glare
primitives.description: Soaring 16-fluted cylindrical column of spun silica and asteroid glass providing cover against the sweeping beam of the Solar Focus.

primitives.name: Airborne Spun-Silica Archive Bookcase
primitives.stage_role: Chancel Ephemeris Shelf: Holds the Three Registers & Solar Charts
primitives.description: Curved glass shelves containing stellar ephemerides, astral charts, and grimoire folios.
